target: measured drain current between three disclosed gate-voltage calibration anchors
timing: offline sparse-characterization task: three responses at -20,0,20 V are obtained before reconstructing other gate points; not an uncalibrated or causal sweep forecast
calibration: Exactly three same-device current measurements at Vg=-20,0,20 V; all models see the same anchors; those points excluded from scores.
scope: 36 fabricated FET curves from source Fig2e, not independent lots; no memory-retention extrapolation, no device-geometry control or interventions.
metric: mean over independent groups of mean absolute target error; every eligible row in a group equally weighted
validation: leave-one-development-group-out; all rows, sibling widths/runs and calibration linked; confirmation held separately
confirmation: SPLITS.json hash allocation before target analysis; no confirmation summaries accessed
schema_exposure: Source CSV headers and first data row per asset inspected; case21 die1A13 waveforms inspected and forced development. Development-only descriptive targets inspected. Public paper prior analyses already source-aware. This is internal withheld-group confirmation, not new experiment.
selection: minimize development group-balanced MAE among attempts; if within1% choose fewer coefficients; baselines compete and remain eligible as reference. No confirmation selection.
stopping: At least5 substantive attempts, then stop after two consecutive candidates do not improve development prediction by1%, worst-group error, or supported simplification/interpretation; max9 attempts before explicit unresolved hypothesis report.
uncertainty: Individual group errors; empirical group range, no row bootstrap or population CI.
target_safety: Native prepare can construct all records for deterministic integrity, but develop loads development.csv.gz only; confirm separately gated by FREEZE.json.
thresholds: No industrial acceptance threshold invented; predictive errors are diagnostic.
